note: Literature indicates brain MRIs in SCAF4 patients typically show normal results or minor non-specific changes (such as mild hypomyelination) rather than gross structural brain malformations.

evidence.text: Brain MRIs evaluated in SCAF4-affected individuals revealed nonspecific findings such as subcortical or periventricular hypomyelination or normal findings rather than major structural brain malformations.

source.title: Variants in SCAF4 cause a neurodevelopmental disorder and are associated with impaired mRNA processing
source.quote: Brain MRIs were performed in five individuals showing nonspecific ... MRI anom. subcort., periventr. hypomyelination.
